high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for an upcoming product launch by Apple. It features two distinct products: the HomePod Mini on the left and the new Apple TV on the right. Objects: The HomePod Mini is a spherical device with a mesh-like texture, designed to blend seamlessly into any home decor. It is white in color. The new Apple TV is a rectangular device with rounded edges, featuring a sleek black design and the iconic Apple logo in the center. Setting: The background is a gradient of blue shades, transitioning from dark blue at the top to light blue
